== Quests == Talk to Medicine Man Veetra in the [[Plane of Sky]]. You say, 'hail Medicine Man Veetra' :''Medicine Man Veetra says 'Good day to you. Are you a shaman of [much experience]? '' You say, 'Yes I am a shaman of much experience' :''Medicine Man Veetra says, 'Then welcome to the tests of the medicine man. I have six tasks, each fit for a shaman of great accomplishment. I have the task of the [snake], the [witch doctor], [might], [health], [sight], and of [shrink]. Tell me, which will you attempt first? '' == Shaman Test of Might == Medicine Man Veetra says, 'The test of might it is. Go find a leather cord, and a wind rune meda. Bring them to me when you have them all and I shall reward you.' '''Reward:''' {{:Amulet of the Fang}} {| class="eoTable3" !
